task.title: Capture a Payment Order
task.shortdesc: Collect funds from a buyer-approved PayPal order to complete the transaction.

ul.li: An order with status APPROVED — buyer has confirmed payment
The order id returned when the order was created

step.cmd: Confirm the order status is APPROVED before capturing.
Send a POST request to the capture endpoint.

info.codeblock: curl -X POST \ https://api-m.sandbox.paypal.com/v2/checkout/orders/5O190127TN364715T/capture \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer A21AAFEpH4PsADbl..." \ -H "PayPal-Request-Id: capture-20240915-001"

step.stepresult: Funds are collected. Store the capture id (3C679366HH908993F) for refund operations.

result.p: Payment is complete. Funds are transferred to your PayPal account and will be available for withdrawal according to your payout schedule.

postreq.p: To return funds to the buyer, see .
